```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/v8.css">
<style>
.v8 .cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .statrow{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.v8 .statbig{font-size:34px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.v8 .statlabel{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.v8 .hook{max-width:540px;margin:10px auto 0;padding:0 20px;text-align:center;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.55}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="all"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--txt)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="python"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--blue)}
.v8 .sgb[data-key="r"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--coral)}

.v8 .domainrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;max-width:700px;margin:14px auto 0;padding:0 20px}
.v8 .domainchip{font-size:11.5px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 13px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;white-space:nowrap}
.v8 .domainchip:hover{color:var(--txt);border-color:var(--axis)}
.v8 .domainchip[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--onblue);background:var(--txt);border-color:var(--txt);font-weight:600}
.v8 .domainclear{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:none;border:none;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 4px;font-family:inherit}
.v8 .domainclear:hover{color:var(--txt)}
.v8 .domainclear[hidden]{display:none}

.v8 .matchcount{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px;min-height:1em}

.v8 .tutgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:22px;max-width:1040px;margin:8px auto 0;padding:0 20px 8px}
.v8 .tutcard{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);animation:tutin .4s ease forwards;transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,border-color .22s ease}
.v8 .tutcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 34px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.45);border-color:var(--axis)}
.v8 .tutcard.hidden{display:none}
.v8 .tutaccent{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px}
.v8 .tutaccent.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g1),var(--g2))}
@keyframes tutin{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v8 .tutcard{animation:none;opacity:1;transform:none}}
.v8 .tutcard svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:14px 0}
.v8 .tutimages{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:14px 0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.v8 .tutimages img{width:50%;height:140px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block;background:#fff;transition:transform .35s ease}
.v8 .tutcard:hover .tutimages img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.v8 .tuttop{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding-top:4px}
.v8 .tutlangs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .tutlang{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--pc);color:var(--pc);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc) 12%, transparent);text-decoration:none;transition:background .18s,color .18s}
a.tutlang:hover{background:var(--pc);color:var(--onblue)}
.v8 .tutlang.planned{opacity:.4;border-style:dashed;background:transparent;cursor:default}
.v8 .tutstatus{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;flex:none;margin-top:5px}
.v8 .tutdot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;position:relative}
.v8 .tutdot.live::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:inherit;animation:tutpulse 2.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes tutpulse{0%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(2.6)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v8 .tutdot.live::after{animation:none;display:none}}
.v8 .tuttitle{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin:2px 0 12px;color:var(--txt)}
.v8 .tutdomains{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.v8 .tutdomains span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--faint);border-radius:10px;padding:3px 9px}
.v8 .tutdesc{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin:10px 0 0;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.v8 .tutmore{text-align:center;padding:36px 20px 8px}
.v8 .tutmore p{text-align:center;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:520px}

.v8 .tutmodal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
.v8 .tutmodal.open{display:flex}
.v8 .tutmodal-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.v8 .tutmodal-panel{position:relative;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;width:min(1100px,100%);height:min(88vh,900px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);overflow:hidden}
.v8 .tutmodal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel)}
.v8 .tutmodal-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.v8 .tutmodal-close{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font-size:18px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
.v8 .tutmodal-close:hover{background:var(--coral);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.v8 .tutmodal-body{flex:1;position:relative;background:var(--bg)}
.v8 .tutmodal-body iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
body.tutmodal-lock{overflow:hidden}
@media (max-width:640px){.v8 .tutmodal{padding:0}.v8 .tutmodal-panel{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:0}}
</style>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
var TUTS=[
 {key:"cartes", title:"Comparer des cartes à différentes résolutions spatiales",
  desc:"Désagrégation de résolution puis scores de concordance (Match, Balanced Match) entre carte prédite et référence — méthode issue d'un article publié.",
  domains:["Analyse spatiale","Cartographie multi-échelle","SIG"],
  langs:[{lang:"r", status:"ready", link:"https://github.com/latsouckfaye/CompareMap", readLink:"tutoriels/comparer-cartes/comparer-cartes.html#r"},
         {lang:"python", status:"ready", link:"https://github.com/latsouckfaye/CompareMap/tree/main/python", readLink:"tutoriels/comparer-cartes/comparer-cartes.html#python"}],
  images:["tutoriels/comparer-cartes/refmap.png","tutoriels/comparer-cartes/predmap.png"]},
 {key:"echantillonnage", title:"Méthodes d'échantillonnage stratégique",
  desc:"Échantillonnage par couverture (k-means) et par complexité du terrain (médoïdes), sur un récif corallien réel.",
  domains:["Analyse spatiale","Échantillonnage","Géomorphologie"],
  langs:[{lang:"r", status:"ready", link:"https://github.com/latsouckfaye/SpatialSampling", readLink:"tutoriels/echantillonnage/echantillonnage.html#r"},
         {lang:"python", status:"ready", link:"https://github.com/latsouckfaye/SpatialSampling/tree/main/python", readLink:"tutoriels/echantillonnage/echantillonnage.html#python"}],
  images:["tutoriels/echantillonnage/Geyser_rough.png","tutoriels/echantillonnage/Geyser_cds.png"]},
 {key:"composition", title:"Analyse spatiale de données de composition",
  desc:"Modèle de régression pour données compositionnelles spatiales, avec zéros structurels.",
  domains:["Analyse spatiale","Données de composition","Régression"],
  langs:[{lang:"r", status:"redaction", link:null},
         {lang:"python", status:"planned", link:null}],
  svg:"composition"}
];

var SVGS={
 composition:"<svg viewBox='0 0 200 68' role='img' aria-label='Graphe de dépendance spatiale entre observations voisines'>"+
  "<g stroke='var(--blue)' stroke-width='1' stroke-opacity='.4'><line x1='26' y1='18' x2='52' y2='34'/><line x1='52' y1='34' x2='40' y2='54'/><line x1='52' y1='34' x2='86' y2='24'/><line x1='86' y1='24' x2='112' y2='42'/><line x1='112' y1='42' x2='146' y2='30'/><line x1='146' y1='30' x2='176' y2='46'/><line x1='112' y1='42' x2='96' y2='58'/><line x1='40' y1='54' x2='70' y2='58'/></g>"+
  "<g class='b'><circle cx='26' cy='18' r='3.2'/><circle cx='52' cy='34' r='3.2'/><circle cx='40' cy='54' r='3.2'/><circle cx='86' cy='24' r='3.2'/><circle cx='112' cy='42' r='3.2'/><circle cx='146' cy='30' r='3.2'/><circle cx='176' cy='46' r='3.2'/><circle cx='96' cy='58' r='3.2'/><circle cx='70' cy='58' r='3.2'/></g></svg>"
};

var LANG_META={r:{label:"R", col:"var(--coral)"}, python:{label:"Python", col:"var(--blue)"}};
var STATE_META={
  publie:{color:"#3fbf7f", label:"Publié"},
  redaction:{color:"#e3b341", label:"En cours de rédaction"},
  planned:{color:"var(--muted)", label:"À venir"}
};
function overallState(langs){
  if(langs.some(function(l){return l.status==="ready";})) return "publie";
  if(langs.some(function(l){return l.status==="redaction";})) return "redaction";
  return "planned";
}

var ALL_DOMAINS=[];
TUTS.forEach(function(t){ t.domains.forEach(function(d){ if(ALL_DOMAINS.indexOf(d)===-1) ALL_DOMAINS.push(d); }); });

var statBig=document.getElementById("statBig"), statLabel=document.getElementById("statLabel"),
    tutGrid=document.getElementById("tutGrid"), segTutWrap=document.getElementById("segTut"),
    domainRow=document.getElementById("domainRow"), matchCount=document.getElementById("matchCount");
var filtLang="all", selectedDomains=[];

var tutModal=document.getElementById("tutModal"), tutModalFrame=document.getElementById("tutModalFrame"),
    tutModalTitle=document.getElementById("tutModalTitle");

function openTutModal(url, title){
  tutModalTitle.textContent=title||"";
  tutModalFrame.src=url;
  tutModal.classList.add("open");
  tutModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
  document.body.classList.add("tutmodal-lock");
}
function closeTutModal(){
  tutModal.classList.remove("open");
  tutModal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
  document.body.classList.remove("tutmodal-lock");
  tutModalFrame.src="about:blank";
}
document.getElementById("tutModalClose").addEventListener("click", closeTutModal);
document.getElementById("tutModalBackdrop").addEventListener("click", closeTutModal);
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key==="Escape" && tutModal.classList.contains("open")) closeTutModal();
});
tutGrid.addEventListener("click", function(e){
  var pill=e.target.closest("a.tutlang");
  if(!pill) return;
  if(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey || e.button===1) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  openTutModal(pill.getAttribute("href"), pill.getAttribute("data-title"));
});

function matchesFilters(t){
  var langOk = filtLang==="all" || t.langs.some(function(l){return l.lang===filtLang;});
  var domOk = selectedDomains.length===0 || t.domains.some(function(d){return selectedDomains.indexOf(d)>-1;});
  return langOk && domOk;
}

function render(){
  var readyCount=TUTS.filter(function(t){return overallState(t.langs)==="publie";}).length;
  var otherCount=TUTS.length-readyCount;
  statBig.textContent=readyCount; statBig.style.color="var(--txt)";
  statLabel.textContent=(readyCount>1?"tutoriels publiés":"tutoriel publié")+(otherCount?", "+otherCount+" en préparation":"");

  tutGrid.innerHTML="";
  TUTS.forEach(function(t,i){
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="tutcard";
    card.style.animationDelay=(i*80)+"ms";
    card.setAttribute("data-key",t.key);
    var state=overallState(t.langs), sm=STATE_META[state];
    var readyLangs = t.langs.filter(function(l){return l.status==="ready";});
    var accentStyle = readyLangs.length>1
      ? "--g1:"+LANG_META[readyLangs[0].lang].col+";--g2:"+LANG_META[readyLangs[1].lang].col
      : "background:"+LANG_META[(readyLangs[0]||t.langs[0]).lang].col;
    var langPills=t.langs.map(function(l){
      var lm=LANG_META[l.lang];
      if(l.readLink){
        return "<a class='tutlang' href='"+l.readLink+"' data-title='"+t.title+" — "+lm.label+"' style='--pc:"+lm.col+"'>"+lm.label+"</a>";
      }
      var title=lm.label+(l.status==="redaction"?" — en cours de rédaction":" — à venir");
      return "<span class='tutlang planned' style='--pc:"+lm.col+"' title='"+title+"'>"+lm.label+"</span>";
    }).join("");
    var visual = t.images
      ? "<div class='tutimages'>"+t.images.map(function(src){return "<img src='"+src+"' alt='"+t.title+"' loading='lazy'>";}).join("")+"</div>"
      : SVGS[t.svg];
    card.innerHTML=
      "<div class='tutaccent"+(readyLangs.length>1?" grad":"")+"' style='"+accentStyle+"'></div>"+
      "<div class='tuttop'>"+
      "<div class='tutlangs'>"+langPills+"</div>"+
      "<span class='tutstatus'><span class='tutdot"+(state==="publie"?" live":"")+"' style='background:"+sm.color+"'></span>"+sm.label+"</span>"+
      "</div>"+
      visual+
      "<p class='tuttitle'>"+t.title+"</p>"+
      "<div class='tutdomains'>"+t.domains.map(function(d){return "<span>"+d+"</span>";}).join("")+"</div>"+
      "<p class='tutdesc'>"+t.desc+"</p>";
    tutGrid.appendChild(card);
  });
  applyFilters();
}

function applyFilters(){
  var visible=0;
  tutGrid.querySelectorAll(".tutcard").forEach(function(c){
    var t=TUTS.filter(function(x){return x.key===c.getAttribute("data-key");})[0];
    var ok=matchesFilters(t);
    c.classList.toggle("hidden", !ok);
    if(ok) visible++;
  });
  var filtered = filtLang!=="all" || selectedDomains.length>0;
  matchCount.textContent = filtered ? (visible>1?visible+" tutoriels correspondent aux filtres":visible+" tutoriel correspond aux filtres") : "";
  domainClearBtn.hidden = selectedDomains.length===0;
}

var segTut=document.createElement("div");
segTut.className="seg"; segTutWrap.appendChild(segTut);
[["all","Tout"],["python","Python"],["r","R"]].forEach(function(f){
  var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="sgb"; b.textContent=f[1];
  b.setAttribute("data-key",f[0]);
  b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", f[0]===filtLang);
  b.onclick=function(){
    filtLang=f[0];
    segTut.querySelectorAll(".sgb").forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", x.getAttribute("data-key")===filtLang);});
    applyFilters();
  };
  segTut.appendChild(b);
});

ALL_DOMAINS.forEach(function(d){
  var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="domainchip"; b.textContent=d;
  b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
  b.onclick=function(){
    var idx=selectedDomains.indexOf(d);
    if(idx>-1){ selectedDomains.splice(idx,1); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false"); }
    else { selectedDomains.push(d); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","true"); }
    applyFilters();
  };
  domainRow.appendChild(b);
});
var domainClearBtn=document.createElement("button");
domainClearBtn.className="domainclear"; domainClearBtn.textContent="Réinitialiser";
domainClearBtn.hidden=true;
domainClearBtn.onclick=function(){
  selectedDomains=[];
  domainRow.querySelectorAll(".domainchip").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");});
  applyFilters();
};
domainRow.appendChild(domainClearBtn);

render();
})();
</script>
```
